name: content-navigator
description: Content Navigator is a VSCode/Codium extension which helps security content authors to create content for https://github.com/ComplianceAsCode/content

paragraphs: Content Navigator is a VSCode/VSCodium extension which helps security content authors to create content for ComplianceAsCode/content by enabling faster navigation between content files, by providing awareness of existent content and snippets to reduce boilerplate. Check the website and this blogpost.
